# llms.txt — policy for LLM / AI systems

> This site does not consent to scraping or AI training.

This website and its contents (including personal information and project
details) may not be scraped, crawled, indexed, stored, reproduced, or used
to train, fine-tune, evaluate, or improve any AI, ML, or generative model.

Preferred contact: use the Contact page on this site. Do not bulk-harvest content.
